offers_products.reason: Manufactures asphalt plants, soil remediation plants, combustion systems and heat transfer systems, plus parts.

offers_services.reason: Training, help desk and technician support are post-sale add-ons to equipment; manufacturing is the main offering.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells equipment to road and highway contractors, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are highway and asphalt contractors and other businesses purchasing plants and combustion systems.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue mostly from asphalt plant and equipment sales, bought infrequently; parts are a smaller share.

cyclical_demand.reason: Contractors can defer capital equipment purchases like asphalt plants when highway funding or the economy weakens.

big_ticket.reason: Asphalt plants and combustion systems are large capital machinery purchases made infrequently.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for manufactured equipment, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly road contractors, many small or mid-sized, rather than large enterprises or agencies.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufactures equipment in plants, but growth needs only moderate investment; not heavy like fleets or utilities.

notes: Customer size and asset intensity judged from the equipment-maker profile; the website doesn't state them.
